title: Part Eleven: Elon Musk: the Life

sections.brief: Born Pretoria 28 June 1971; parents and the father's denials; Haldeman's move to Pretoria (link de3_technocracy), his record his own; Musk's own words on his grandfather and on conscription; emerald mine graded; Canada 1989, Queen's, Penn (degrees 1997), Stanford not enrolled; WaPo 2024 work-status report, 2005 email and his reply; citizenship; his statements on South Africa as his own. Figures: time, compare

Zip2 1995, Mohr Davidow 1996, Compaq sale Feb 1999 (~$22M); X.com 1999, Confinity merger March 2000, ouster Sept 2000, 'buried their hatchet'; eBay 3 Oct 2002 (~$175.8M); PayPal spin-off 2015, no current stake; Musk-Thiel ties by connection type, Founders Fund $20M in SpaceX 2008. Figures: time, compare

Tesla founding and the 2009 co-founder settlement; SpaceX and NASA; WaPo $38bn by instrument (contracts, DOE loan, regulatory credits, state incentives); Starshield $1.8bn NRO; NSSL Phase 3 April 2025; Golden Dome SBI April 2026; Aug 2025 launch-licensing order; Starlink in Ukraine 2022-2026 (Sevastopol, Isaacson correction, Pentagon contract, minerals talks, Sikorski, whitelist). Figures: money, time

Twitter purchase 2022 and co-investors (Ellison, Sequoia, Binance, Qatar Holding, Alwaleed rollover); changes (firings, layoffs, Trump restored, journalists suspended, X); speech and government pressure both ways (Twitter Files, Murthy v. Missouri, Turkey, Brazil); xAI, Grok incidents, CDAO award; xAI-X merger March 2025; Gulf money in xAI; SpaceX-xAI merger Feb 2026; IPO June 2026. Figures: money, compare, time

Ledger: 2024 >$290M (America PAC ~$250M; giveaways >$50M), Wisconsin 2025 >$20M, 2026 cycle ~$366M to Sept and >$440M with October (SLF, America PAC, Paxton PACs); DOGE office as sequence (link de17); feud June 2025, America Party July 2025, reconciliation, Medal of Science Oct 2026; contracts and PSI minority memo; timing not causation; where the record runs against the bought-government reading. Figures: money, flow

Rubric on 13 of Musk's claims: funding secured, random giveaway, work status (RED); robotaxis, DOGE savings (ORANGE); 'done enough', Trump-Epstein post, Epstein framing (YELLOW); free speech, gesture, minerals talks (GREY); Crimea and Tesla co-founder (no flag); each with his explanation; worst-case reading tested.
